"""USDA FoodData Central, Foundation Foods — licence group A (CC0 1.0).

The reference source module (README "Source rules"): `extract` copies the
in-scope rows in USDA's own shape; `canonicalise` applies dictionary/ and
nothing else.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import shutil
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from ..canonical_io import CanonicalError, write_canonical
from ..dictionary import Dictionary
from ..lake import (Lake, read_csv, read_json, sha256_file, staged_directory, tool_revision,
                    utc_now, write_json)
from ..model import Food, FoodName, Value
from ..values import NegativeAmount, UnrecognisedValue, convert, qualify, select

NAMESPACE = "usda"
MANIFEST = "usda"
RELEASE_FOLDER = "FoodData_Central_csv_2026-04-30"
DATA_TYPES = ("foundation_food",)
BASIS = "per_100g"  # FDC reports every nutrient amount per 100 g of food
SCOPED_TABLES = ("food.csv", "food_nutrient.csv", "food_portion.csv")
WHOLE_TABLES = ("foundation_food.csv", "nutrient.csv", "food_nutrient_derivation.csv",
                "food_category.csv", "measure_unit.csv")
CANONICAL_INPUTS = ("food.csv", "foundation_food.csv", "food_nutrient.csv", "nutrient.csv",
                    "food_nutrient_derivation.csv", "food_category.csv")


def _filter_rows(src: Path, dst: Path, keep) -> int:
    """Copies the header and every row `keep(row, column_index)` accepts. Cells untouched."""
    kept = 0
    with open(src, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fin, \
            open(dst, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fout:
        reader = csv.reader(fin)
        writer = csv.writer(fout, lineterminator="\n", quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)
        header = next(reader)
        writer.writerow(header)
        column = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(header)}
        for row in reader:
            if keep(row, column):
                writer.writerow(row)
                kept += 1
    return kept


def extract(lake: Lake) -> Path:
    inputs = lake.verify_inputs(MANIFEST, [f"{RELEASE_FOLDER}/{t}" for t in SCOPED_TABLES + WHOLE_TABLES])
    source = lake.source_dir(MANIFEST) / RELEASE_FOLDER
    out = lake.extracted(NAMESPACE)
    with staged_directory(out) as scratch:
        in_scope: set[str] = set()

        def foundation(row, column):
            if row[column["data_type"]] in DATA_TYPES:
                in_scope.add(row[column["fdc_id"]])
                return True
            return False

        rows = {"food.csv": _filter_rows(source / "food.csv", scratch / "food.csv", foundation)}
        for table in SCOPED_TABLES[1:]:
            rows[table] = _filter_rows(source / table, scratch / table,
                                       lambda row, column: row[column["fdc_id"]] in in_scope)
        for table in WHOLE_TABLES:
            shutil.copyfile(source / table, scratch / table)
        write_json(scratch / "manifest.json", {
            "stage": "extract",
            "namespace": NAMESPACE,
            "release": lake.manifest(MANIFEST)["release"],
            "data_types": list(DATA_TYPES),
            "generated_at": utc_now(),
            "tool_revision": tool_revision(),
            "inputs": inputs,
            "rows_kept": rows,
            "outputs": {p.name: sha256_file(p) for p in sorted(scratch.iterdir())},
        })
    return out


def canonicalise(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> dict:
    ext = lake.extracted(NAMESPACE)
    extracted = read_json(ext / "manifest.json")
    for name in CANONICAL_INPUTS:
        if extracted["outputs"].get(name) != sha256_file(ext / name):
            raise CanonicalError(f"{ext / name} changed after extraction; re-run `extract usda`")
    inputs = [{"file": f"processed/extracted/{NAMESPACE}/{name}", "sha256": extracted["outputs"][name]}
              for name in CANONICAL_INPUTS]

    group = dictionary.group_of(NAMESPACE)
    listed = {r["fdc_id"] for r in read_csv(ext / "foundation_food.csv")}
    categories = {r["id"]: r for r in read_csv(ext / "food_category.csv")}
    derivation_codes = {r["id"]: r["code"] for r in read_csv(ext / "food_nutrient_derivation.csv")}
    units = {r["id"]: r["unit_name"] for r in read_csv(ext / "nutrient.csv")}
    mappings = dictionary.mappings_for(NAMESPACE)
    for maps in mappings.values():
        for m in maps:
            if units.get(m.source_nutrient_id) != m.source_unit:
                raise CanonicalError(f"nutrient_map.csv gives usda {m.source_nutrient_id} unit "
                                     f"{m.source_unit!r}; nutrient.csv says "
                                     f"{units.get(m.source_nutrient_id)!r}")
    tokens = dictionary.tokens_for(NAMESPACE)
    derivations = dictionary.derivations_for(NAMESPACE)

    foods: list[Food] = []
    names: list[FoodName] = []
    excluded: list[dict] = []
    for row in read_csv(ext / "food.csv"):
        fdc_id = row["fdc_id"]
        if fdc_id not in listed:
            excluded.append({"fdc_id": fdc_id, "description": row["description"],
                             "publication_date": row["publication_date"],
                             "reason": "data_type foundation_food but not listed in "
                                       "foundation_food.csv (superseded or withdrawn record)"})
            continue
        category = categories.get(row["food_category_id"], {})
        food = Food(NAMESPACE, fdc_id, group, category.get("code", ""),
                    category.get("description", ""), f"food.csv fdc_id={fdc_id}")
        foods.append(food)
        names.append(FoodName(food.food_ref, "en", row["description"].strip(), True))

    kept = {f.local_id for f in foods}
    mapped = {m.source_nutrient_id for maps in mappings.values() for m in maps}
    by_food: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = defaultdict(dict)
    unmapped_duplicates: list[dict] = []
    for row in read_csv(ext / "food_nutrient.csv"):
        if row["fdc_id"] not in kept:
            continue
        if row["nutrient_id"] in by_food[row["fdc_id"]]:
            if row["nutrient_id"] in mapped:
                raise CanonicalError(f"usda:{row['fdc_id']} has two food_nutrient rows for nutrient "
                                     f"{row['nutrient_id']}; refusing to pick one")
            # Not canonicalised in this phase, so nothing is picked — but a reviewer should know.
            unmapped_duplicates.append({"fdc_id": row["fdc_id"], "nutrient_id": row["nutrient_id"],
                                        "food_nutrient_ids": [by_food[row["fdc_id"]][row["nutrient_id"]]["id"],
                                                              row["id"]]})
            continue
        by_food[row["fdc_id"]][row["nutrient_id"]] = row

    values: list[Value] = []
    rejected: list[dict] = []
    for food in foods:
        published = by_food.get(food.local_id, {})
        for nutrient_id, maps in mappings.items():
            candidates = []
            for m in maps:
                row = published.get(m.source_nutrient_id)
                if row is None or not row["amount"].strip():
                    continue
                code = derivation_codes.get(row["derivation_id"]) if row["derivation_id"] else ""
                if code is None:
                    raise CanonicalError(f"{food.food_ref}: derivation_id {row['derivation_id']!r} "
                                         "is not in food_nutrient_derivation.csv")
                if code not in derivations:
                    raise CanonicalError(f"USDA derivation code {code!r} has no row in "
                                         "dictionary/derivation_qualifiers.csv")
                try:
                    qualified = qualify(row["amount"], tokens=tokens,
                                        numeric_override=m.numeric_qualifier_override,
                                        derivation_qualifier=derivations[code])
                except NegativeAmount:
                    # USDA publishes a negative "carbohydrate, by difference" where the other
                    # proximates sum past 100 g. Not a quantity: no row, and it is recorded.
                    rejected.append({"food_ref": food.food_ref, "source_nutrient_id": m.source_nutrient_id,
                                     "source_value": row["amount"], "reason": "negative amount"})
                    continue
                except UnrecognisedValue as error:
                    raise CanonicalError(f"{food.food_ref} nutrient {m.source_nutrient_id}: {error}") from error
                candidates.append((m.priority, qualified, (m, row, code)))
            chosen = select(candidates)
            if chosen is None:
                continue
            _, qualified, (m, row, code) = chosen
            values.append(Value(food.food_ref, nutrient_id, BASIS,
                                convert(qualified.amount, m.unit_conversion), qualified.qualifier,
                                code, row["amount"].strip(), m.source_nutrient_id,
                                units[m.source_nutrient_id], group))

    return write_canonical(lake.canonical(NAMESPACE), namespace=NAMESPACE, foods=foods, names=names,
                           values=values, dictionary=dictionary, inputs=inputs,
                           notes={"data_types": list(DATA_TYPES), "excluded": excluded,
                                  "rejected_values": rejected,
                                  "unmapped_duplicates": unmapped_duplicates})

1	"""Canonical rows (Processing Design v0.1 §2–§4) and the checks every stage runs on them."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import math
5	import re
6	from collections import Counter
7	from dataclasses import dataclass
8	from typing import Sequence
9	
10	from .dictionary import Dictionary
11	from .values import parse_decimal
12	
13	BASES = ("per_100g", "per_100ml")
14	_LANGUAGE = re.compile(r"[a-z]{2,3}")
15	
16	
17	@dataclass(frozen=True)
18	class Food:
19	    namespace: str
20	    local_id: str
21	    licence_group: str
22	    food_group_code: str
23	    food_group_name: str
24	    source_record: str
25	
26	    @property
27	    def food_ref(self) -> str:
28	        return f"{self.namespace}:{self.local_id}"
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class FoodName:
33	    food_ref: str
34	    language: str
35	    name: str
36	    is_primary: bool
37	
38	
39	@dataclass(frozen=True)
40	class Value:
41	    food_ref: str
42	    nutrient_id: str
43	    basis: str
44	    amount: float | None
45	    qualifier: str
46	    confidence: str
47	    source_value: str
48	    source_nutrient_id: str
49	    source_unit: str
50	    licence_group: str
51	
52	
53	def validate(foods: Sequence[Food], names: Sequence[FoodName], values: Sequence[Value],
54	             dictionary: Dictionary, *, namespace: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
55	    """Every rule a canonical row set must satisfy. An empty list means valid.
56	
57	    `namespace` confines the set to one source (the canonical stage); the
58	    union stage passes None and every row is checked against its own source.
59	    """
60	    problems: list[str] = []
61	
62	    foods_by_ref: dict[str, Food] = {}
63	    for f in foods:
64	        where = f"food {f.food_ref}"
65	        if namespace is not None and f.namespace != namespace:
66	            problems.append(f"{where}: namespace {f.namespace!r} in canonical/{namespace}")
67	        if f.namespace not in dictionary.sources:
68	            problems.append(f"{where}: namespace {f.namespace!r} is not in sources.csv")
69	            continue
70	        if not f.local_id or f.local_id != f.local_id.strip():
71	            problems.append(f"{where}: local_id must be non-empty and trimmed")
72	        if f.licence_group != dictionary.group_of(f.namespace):
73	            problems.append(f"{where}: licence group {f.licence_group!r}, but sources.csv says "
74	                            f"{dictionary.group_of(f.namespace)!r}")
75	        if f.food_ref in foods_by_ref:
76	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate food_ref")
77	        foods_by_ref[f.food_ref] = f
78	
79	    primaries: Counter[str] = Counter()
80	    seen_names: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
81	    for n in names:
82	        where = f"name {n.food_ref}/{n.language}"
83	        if n.food_ref not in foods_by_ref:
84	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown food")
85	        if not _LANGUAGE.fullmatch(n.language):
86	            problems.append(f"{where}: language must be a lower-case ISO 639 code")
87	        if not n.name.strip():
88	            problems.append(f"{where}: empty name")
89	        if (n.food_ref, n.language) in seen_names:
90	            problems.append(f"{where}: two names in one language")
91	        seen_names.add((n.food_ref, n.language))
92	        primaries[n.food_ref] += n.is_primary
93	    for ref in foods_by_ref:
94	        if primaries[ref] != 1:
95	            problems.append(f"food {ref}: {primaries[ref]} primary names, needs exactly 1")
96	
97	    seen_values: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
98	    for v in values:
99	        where = f"value {v.food_ref}/{v.nutrient_id}/{v.basis}"
100	        food = foods_by_ref.get(v.food_ref)
101	        if food is None:
102	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown food")
103	            continue
104	        if v.nutrient_id not in dictionary.nutrients:
105	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown nutrient")
106	        if v.basis not in BASES:
107	            problems.append(f"{where}: basis must be one of {BASES}")
108	        qualifier = dictionary.qualifiers.get(v.qualifier)
109	        if qualifier is None:
110	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown qualifier {v.qualifier!r}")
111	        elif qualifier.amount_rule == "null" and v.amount is not None:
112	            problems.append(f"{where}: {v.qualifier} must have no amount, got {v.amount!r} "
113	                            "— a token is never coerced to a number")
114	        elif qualifier.amount_rule == "required" and v.amount is None:
115	            problems.append(f"{where}: {v.qualifier} requires an amount")
116	        if v.amount is not None and (not math.isfinite(v.amount) or v.amount < 0):
117	            problems.append(f"{where}: amount {v.amount!r} is not a finite non-negative number")
118	        if v.qualifier == "zero_reported" and v.amount != 0:
119	            problems.append(f"{where}: zero_reported with amount {v.amount!r}")
120	        # Independent of the qualifier logic: only a cell that says zero may become 0.
121	        if v.amount == 0 and parse_decimal(v.source_value, decimal_comma=True) != 0:
122	            problems.append(f"{where}: amount 0 from source cell {v.source_value!r} "
123	                            "— only an explicit zero may become 0")
124	        if not v.source_value.strip():
125	            problems.append(f"{where}: source_value is empty")
126	        if not v.source_nutrient_id or not v.source_unit:

"""Reading and writing canonical row sets (README "Canonical format").

The same three files describe processed/canonical/{namespace}/ and
processed/union/; only the manifest differs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, Sequence

from .dictionary import Dictionary
from .lake import (read_csv, read_json, sha256_file, staged_directory, tool_revision, utc_now,
                   write_csv, write_json)
from .model import Food, FoodName, Value, validate

ROW_FILES = ("foods.csv", "food_names.csv", "values.csv")
FOOD_COLUMNS = ["food_ref", "namespace", "local_id", "licence_group", "food_group_code",
                "food_group_name", "source_record"]
NAME_COLUMNS = ["food_ref", "language", "name", "is_primary"]
VALUE_COLUMNS = ["food_ref", "nutrient_id", "basis", "amount", "qualifier", "confidence",
                 "source_value", "source_nutrient_id", "source_unit", "licence_group"]


class CanonicalError(ValueError):
    """A row set breaks the contract. Nothing is written."""


def format_amount(amount: float | None) -> str:
    return "" if amount is None else repr(float(amount))


def parse_amount(text: str) -> float | None:
    return None if text == "" else float(text)


def raise_if_invalid(problems: Sequence[str], what: str) -> None:
    if problems:
        shown = "\n  ".join(problems[:30])
        more = f"\n  … and {len(problems) - 30} more" if len(problems) > 30 else ""
        raise CanonicalError(f"{what}: {len(problems)} problem(s)\n  {shown}{more}")


def counts(foods: Sequence[Food], names: Sequence[FoodName], values: Sequence[Value]) -> dict:
    return {
        "foods": len(foods),
        "names": len(names),
        "values": len(values),
        "values_by_nutrient": dict(sorted(Counter(v.nutrient_id for v in values).items())),
        "values_by_qualifier": dict(sorted(Counter(v.qualifier for v in values).items())),
        "values_by_basis": dict(sorted(Counter(v.basis for v in values).items())),
        "foods_without_values": len({f.food_ref for f in foods} - {v.food_ref for v in values}),
    }


def write_rows(directory: Path, foods: Iterable[Food], names: Iterable[FoodName],
               values: Iterable[Value]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Writes the three row files in key order; returns their SHA-256s."""
    write_csv(directory / "foods.csv", FOOD_COLUMNS, (
        [f.food_ref, f.namespace, f.local_id, f.licence_group, f.food_group_code,
         f.food_group_name, f.source_record]
        for f in sorted(foods, key=lambda f: f.food_ref)))
    write_csv(directory / "food_names.csv", NAME_COLUMNS, (
        [n.food_ref, n.language, n.name, "1" if n.is_primary else "0"]
        for n in sorted(names, key=lambda n: (n.food_ref, n.language))))
    write_csv(directory / "values.csv", VALUE_COLUMNS, (
        [v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis, format_amount(v.amount), v.qualifier, v.confidence,
         v.source_value, v.source_nutrient_id, v.source_unit, v.licence_group]
        for v in sorted(values, key=lambda v: (v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis))))
    return {name: sha256_file(directory / name) for name in ROW_FILES}


def write_canonical(out_dir: Path, *, namespace: str, foods: Iterable[Food],
                    names: Iterable[FoodName], values: Iterable[Value], dictionary: Dictionary,
                    inputs: list[dict], notes: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Validates, then replaces `out_dir`. An invalid set leaves the old output untouched."""
    foods, names, values = list(foods), list(names), list(values)
    raise_if_invalid(validate(foods, names, values, dictionary, namespace=namespace),
                     f"canonical/{namespace}")
    source = dictionary.sources[namespace]
    with staged_directory(out_dir) as scratch:
        manifest = {
            "stage": "canonical",
            "namespace": namespace,
            "dataset_id": source.dataset_id,
            "release": source.release,
            "licence_group": source.licence_group,
            "dictionary_sha256": dictionary.sha256,
            "generated_at": utc_now(),
            "tool_revision": tool_revision(),
            "inputs": inputs,
            "outputs": write_rows(scratch, foods, names, values),
            "counts": counts(foods, names, values),
            "notes": notes or {},
        }
        write_json(scratch / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest


def read_rows(directory: Path) -> tuple[list[Food], list[FoodName], list[Value]]:
    foods = []
    for r in read_csv(directory / "foods.csv"):
        food = Food(r["namespace"], r["local_id"], r["licence_group"], r["food_group_code"],
                    r["food_group_name"], r["source_record"])
        if r["food_ref"] != food.food_ref:
            raise CanonicalError(f"{directory}/foods.csv: food_ref {r['food_ref']!r} is not "
                                 f"namespace:local_id ({food.food_ref!r})")
        foods.append(food)
    names = [FoodName(r["food_ref"], r["language"], r["name"], r["is_primary"] == "1")
             for r in read_csv(directory / "food_names.csv")]
    values = [Value(r["food_ref"], r["nutrient_id"], r["basis"], parse_amount(r["amount"]),
                    r["qualifier"], r["confidence"], r["source_value"], r["source_nutrient_id"],
                    r["source_unit"], r["licence_group"])
              for r in read_csv(directory / "values.csv")]
    return foods, names, values


def read_canonical(directory: Path) -> tuple[list[Food], list[FoodName], list[Value], dict]:
    """Reads a row set and refuses it if any file changed after its manifest was written."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    manifest = read_json(directory / "manifest.json")
    for name in ROW_FILES:
        actual = sha256_file(directory / name)
        if manifest.get("outputs", {}).get(name) != actual:
            raise CanonicalError(f"{directory}/{name} does not match its manifest "
                                 "(edited after it was written?) — regenerate it")
    return (*read_rows(directory), manifest)

1	"""Turning one source cell into (amount, qualifier) — Processing Design v0.1 §2.
2	
3	The most consequential bug available in this project is a one-line type
4	coercion that turns CoFID's `Tr` or `N` into 0. Every source goes through
5	`qualify`, which has no path from a non-numeric cell to a number other than
6	an explicit, bounded `< x`.
7	"""
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import math
11	import re
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from typing import Any, Sequence
14	
15	KJ_PER_KCAL = 4.184  # thermochemical calorie
16	_DECIMAL = re.compile(r"[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?")
17	
18	
19	class UnrecognisedValue(ValueError):
20	    """A cell no rule covers. The stage fails rather than guess."""
21	
22	
23	class NegativeAmount(UnrecognisedValue):
24	    """A published number below zero — not a quantity. Never stored, never clamped to 0.
25	
26	    Source modules may catch this one case, emit no row, and record the cell in
27	    their manifest's notes.rejected_values (README "Qualifying a value").
28	    """
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class Qualified:
33	    amount: float | None
34	    qualifier: str
35	
36	
37	def parse_decimal(text: str, *, decimal_comma: bool = False) -> float | None:
38	    """A plain finite decimal, or None. Never NaN, never infinity, never a token."""
39	    s = text.strip()
40	    if decimal_comma and s.count(",") == 1 and "." not in s:
41	        s = s.replace(",", ".")
42	    if not _DECIMAL.fullmatch(s):
43	        return None
44	    number = float(s)
45	    return number if math.isfinite(number) else None
46	
47	
48	def qualify(cell: str, *, tokens: dict[str, str], numeric_override: str = "",
49	            derivation_qualifier: str = "", decimal_comma: bool = False,
50	            bound_prefix: str = "") -> Qualified:
51	    """The README's seven-step rule, in order. Blank cells never get here."""
52	    text = cell.strip()
53	    if not text:
54	        raise UnrecognisedValue("blank cell reached qualify(); a blank cell produces no row")
55	    if text in tokens:
56	        return Qualified(None, tokens[text])
57	    if bound_prefix and text.startswith(bound_prefix):
58	        bound = parse_decimal(text[len(bound_prefix):], decimal_comma=decimal_comma)
59	        if bound is None or bound <= 0:
60	            raise UnrecognisedValue(f"{cell!r}: a bound must be a positive number")
61	        return Qualified(bound, "below_loq")
62	    number = parse_decimal(text, decimal_comma=decimal_comma)
63	    if number is None:
64	        raise UnrecognisedValue(f"{cell!r} is neither a number nor a known token")
65	    if number < 0:
66	        raise NegativeAmount(f"{cell!r}: a nutrient amount cannot be negative")
67	    if number == 0:
68	        return Qualified(0.0, "zero_reported")
69	    if numeric_override:
70	        return Qualified(number, numeric_override)
71	    if derivation_qualifier:
72	        return Qualified(number, derivation_qualifier)
73	    return Qualified(number, "measured")
74	
75	
76	def convert(amount: float | None, conversion: str) -> float | None:
77	    if amount is None or not conversion:
78	        return amount
79	    if conversion == "kj_to_kcal":
80	        return amount / KJ_PER_KCAL
81	    raise ValueError(f"unknown unit conversion {conversion!r}")
82	
83	
84	def select(candidates: Sequence[tuple[int, Qualified, Any]]) -> tuple[int, Qualified, Any] | None:
85	    """One value where several source columns feed one canonical nutrient.
86	
87	    `candidates` are (priority, Qualified, payload). The lowest priority that
88	    carries a quantity wins; if none does, the lowest priority's marker is
89	    kept rather than dropped.
90	    """
91	    ordered = sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: c[0])
92	    for candidate in ordered:
93	        if candidate[1].qualifier != "not_analysed":
94	            return candidate
95	    return ordered[0] if ordered else None
96

2	
3	Processing Design v0.1 §6: the mapping "will be wrong in places on the first
4	pass. Keeping it as data means fixing it is an update, not a re-extraction."
5	Nothing in the pipeline hard-codes a nutrient, a qualifier or a licence group;
6	it all comes from ../dictionary/, cross-checked here.
7	"""
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import csv
11	import hashlib
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from pathlib import Path
14	
15	DICTIONARY_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "dictionary"
16	FILES = ("nutrients.csv", "qualifiers.csv", "licence_groups.csv", "sources.csv",
17	         "nutrient_map.csv", "derivation_qualifiers.csv", "value_tokens.csv")
18	
19	# unit_conversion name -> (source unit, canonical unit), compared case-insensitively.
20	# The empty name is the identity: the two units must already agree.
21	UNIT_CONVERSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, str] | None] = {"": None, "kj_to_kcal": ("kj", "kcal")}
22	
23	
24	class DictionaryError(ValueError):
25	    """The dictionary contradicts itself. The message lists every problem."""
26	
27	
28	@dataclass(frozen=True)
29	class Nutrient:
30	    nutrient_id: str
31	    infoods_tag: str
32	    name: str
33	    unit: str
34	    description: str
35	
36	
37	@dataclass(frozen=True)
38	class Qualifier:
39	    qualifier: str
40	    has_quantity: bool
41	    directly_observed: bool
42	    amount_rule: str  # "null": amount is always empty; "required": amount is always present
43	    description: str
44	
45	
46	@dataclass(frozen=True)
47	class LicenceGroup:
48	    licence_group: str
49	    name: str
50	    shippable: bool
51	    description: str
52	
53	
54	@dataclass(frozen=True)
55	class Source:
56	    namespace: str
57	    dataset_id: str
58	    name: str
59	    release: str
60	    licence: str
61	    licence_group: str
62	    attribution: str
63	    url: str

65	
66	@dataclass(frozen=True)
67	class Mapping:
68	    source: str
69	    source_nutrient_id: str
70	    source_nutrient_name: str
71	    source_unit: str
72	    nutrient_id: str
73	    priority: int

79	@dataclass(frozen=True)
80	class Dictionary:
81	    nutrients: dict[str, Nutrient]
82	    qualifiers: dict[str, Qualifier]
83	    licence_groups: dict[str, LicenceGroup]
84	    sources: dict[str, Source]
85	    mappings: tuple[Mapping, ...]
86	    derivations: dict[tuple[str, str], str]  # (source, code) -> qualifier
87	    tokens: dict[tuple[str, str], str]  # (source, exact cell text) -> qualifier
88	    sha256: str
89	
90	    @property
91	    def shippable_groups(self) -> frozenset[str]:
92	        return frozenset(g for g, row in self.licence_groups.items() if row.shippable)
93	
94	    def group_of(self, namespace: str) -> str:
95	        return self.sources[namespace].licence_group
96	
97	    def mappings_for(self, source: str) -> dict[str, list[Mapping]]:
98	        """Canonical nutrient -> the source's mappings for it, highest priority first."""
99	        grouped: dict[str, list[Mapping]] = {}
100	        for mapping in self.mappings:
101	            if mapping.source == source:
102	                grouped.setdefault(mapping.nutrient_id, []).append(mapping)
103	        return {n: sorted(ms, key=lambda m: m.priority) for n, ms in sorted(grouped.items())}
104	
105	    def tokens_for(self, source: str) -> dict[str, str]:
106	        return {token: q for (src, token), q in self.tokens.items() if src == source}
107	
108	    def derivations_for(self, source: str) -> dict[str, str]:
109	        return {code: q for (src, code), q in self.derivations.items() if src == source}

116	
117	def _flag(text: str, where: str, problems: list[str]) -> bool:
118	    if text not in ("true", "false"):
119	        problems.append(f"{where}: expected true or false, got {text!r}")
120	    return text == "true"
121	
122	
123	def _digest(directory: Path) -> str:
124	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
125	    for name in FILES:
126	        digest.update(name.encode() + b"\0" + (directory / name).read_bytes() + b"\0")
127	    return digest.hexdigest()
128	
129	
130	def load(directory: Path | str = DICTIONARY_DIR) -> Dictionary:
131	    directory = Path(directory)
132	    problems: list[str] = []
133	
134	    nutrients: dict[str, Nutrient] = {}
135	    for r in _read(directory, "nutrients.csv"):
136	        if r["nutrient_id"] in nutrients:
137	            problems.append(f"nutrients.csv: duplicate nutrient_id {r['nutrient_id']}")
138	        if not r["unit"]:
139	            problems.append(f"nutrients.csv[{r['nutrient_id']}]: unit is empty")
140	        nutrients[r["nutrient_id"]] = Nutrient(r["nutrient_id"], r["infoods_tag"], r["name"],
141	                                               r["unit"], r["description"])
142	
143	    qualifiers: dict[str, Qualifier] = {}
144	    for r in _read(directory, "qualifiers.csv"):
145	        where = f"qualifiers.csv[{r['qualifier']}]"
146	        if r["qualifier"] in qualifiers:
147	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate")
148	        if r["amount_rule"] not in ("null", "required"):
149	            problems.append(f"{where}: amount_rule must be null or required")
150	        qualifiers[r["qualifier"]] = Qualifier(
151	            r["qualifier"], _flag(r["has_quantity"], where, problems),
152	            _flag(r["directly_observed"], where, problems), r["amount_rule"], r["description"])
153	
154	    groups: dict[str, LicenceGroup] = {}
155	    for r in _read(directory, "licence_groups.csv"):
156	        where = f"licence_groups.csv[{r['licence_group']}]"
157	        if r["licence_group"] in groups:
158	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate")
159	        groups[r["licence_group"]] = LicenceGroup(r["licence_group"], r["name"],
160	                                                  _flag(r["shippable"], where, problems),
161	                                                  r["description"])
162	
163	    sources: dict[str, Source] = {}
164	    for r in _read(directory, "sources.csv"):
165	        where = f"sources.csv[{r['namespace']}]"
166	        if r["namespace"] in sources:
167	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate")
168	        if r["licence_group"] not in groups:
169	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown licence group {r['licence_group']!r}")
170	        sources[r["namespace"]] = Source(r["namespace"], r["dataset_id"], r["name"], r["release"],
171	                                         r["licence"], r["licence_group"], r["attribution"], r["url"])
172	
173	    mappings: list[Mapping] = []
174	    seen_ids: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
175	    seen_priorities: set[tuple[str, str, int]] = set()
176	    for r in _read(directory, "nutrient_map.csv"):
177	        where = f"nutrient_map.csv[{r['source']} {r['source_nutrient_id']}]"
178	        try:
179	            priority = int(r["priority"])
180	        except ValueError:
181	            problems.append(f"{where}: priority {r['priority']!r} is not an integer")
182	            continue
183	        m = Mapping(r["source"], r["source_nutrient_id"], r["source_nutrient_name"], r["source_unit"],
184	                    r["nutrient_id"], priority, r["unit_conversion"],
185	                    r["numeric_qualifier_override"], r["notes"])
186	        if m.source not in sources:
187	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown source")
188	        nutrient = nutrients.get(m.nutrient_id)
189	        if nutrient is None:
190	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown nutrient {m.nutrient_id!r}")
191	        if (m.source, m.source_nutrient_id) in seen_ids:
192	            problems.append(f"{where}: mapped twice")
193	        seen_ids.add((m.source, m.source_nutrient_id))
194	        if (m.source, m.nutrient_id, m.priority) in seen_priorities:
195	            problems.append(f"{where}: priority {priority} repeated for {m.nutrient_id}")
196	        seen_priorities.add((m.source, m.nutrient_id, m.priority))
197	        if priority < 1:
198	            problems.append(f"{where}: priority must be 1 or more")
199	        if m.numeric_qualifier_override and m.numeric_qualifier_override not in qualifiers:
200	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown override qualifier {m.numeric_qualifier_override!r}")
201	        if m.unit_conversion not in UNIT_CONVERSIONS:
202	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown unit_conversion {m.unit_conversion!r}")
203	        elif nutrient is not None:
204	            conversion = UNIT_CONVERSIONS[m.unit_conversion]
205	            source_unit, canonical_unit = m.source_unit.lower(), nutrient.unit.lower()
206	            if conversion is None and source_unit != canonical_unit:
207	                problems.append(f"{where}: source unit {m.source_unit!r} is not {nutrient.unit!r} "
208	                                "and no unit_conversion is given")
209	            if conversion is not None and conversion != (source_unit, canonical_unit):
210	                problems.append(f"{where}: {m.unit_conversion} converts {conversion[0]} to "
211	                                f"{conversion[1]}, not {source_unit} to {canonical_unit}")
212	        mappings.append(m)
213	
214	    derivations: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
215	    for r in _read(directory, "derivation_qualifiers.csv"):
216	        where = f"derivation_qualifiers.csv[{r['source']} {r['code']!r}]"
217	        if r["source"] not in sources:
218	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown source")
219	        if r["qualifier"] not in qualifiers:
220	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown qualifier {r['qualifier']!r}")
221	        if (r["source"], r["code"]) in derivations:
222	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate")
223	        derivations[(r["source"], r["code"])] = r["qualifier"]
224	
225	    tokens: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
226	    for r in _read(directory, "value_tokens.csv"):
227	        where = f"value_tokens.csv[{r['source']} {r['token']!r}]"
228	        if r["source"] not in sources:
229	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown source")
230	        qualifier = qualifiers.get(r["qualifier"])
231	        if qualifier is None:
232	            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown qualifier {r['qualifier']!r}")
233	        elif qualifier.amount_rule != "null":
234	            # A token carries no number. Mapping one to a qualifier that needs an
235	            # amount would force the pipeline to invent one — which is the bug.
236	            problems.append(f"{where}: a token may only map to a qualifier with no amount, "
237	                            f"not {r['qualifier']!r}")
238	        if r["token"] != r["token"].strip() or not r["token"]:
239	            problems.append(f"{where}: token must be non-empty and trimmed")
240	        if (r["source"], r["token"]) in tokens:
241	            problems.append(f"{where}: duplicate")
242	        tokens[(r["source"], r["token"])] = r["qualifier"]
243	
244	    if problems:
245	        raise DictionaryError(f"{len(problems)} problem(s) in {directory}:\n  " + "\n  ".join(problems))
246	    return Dictionary(nutrients, qualifiers, groups, sources, tuple(mappings), derivations, tokens,
247	                      _digest(directory))

139	    for table in ("nutrition_source", "nutrition_food", "nutrition_value"):

141	            if group not in shippable:

143	    if (result := con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]) != "ok":

150	    out_path = Path(out_path or lake.bundle)

152	    if union_manifest.get("dictionary_sha256") != dictionary.sha256:
153	        raise CanonicalError("processed/union was built against a different dictionary; re-run union")
154	    raise_if_invalid(validate(foods, names, values, dictionary), "union")
155	
156	    # The assertion. Nothing has been written yet.

193	                     q.description)
194	                    for q in dictionary.qualifiers.values()])
195	                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_food VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [

201	                    for n in sorted(names, key=lambda n: (n.food_ref, n.language))])

214	    return {

216	        "sha256": sha256_file(out_path),
217	        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
218	        "built_at": built_at,
219	        "namespaces": namespaces,
220	        "rows_checked": checked,
221	        "counts": counts(foods, names, values),

"""union and bundle — Processing Design v0.1 §5.

union   Every canonical source present, re-validated and licence-tagged. It
        may one day hold Group C or D rows: it is a local research artefact.
bundle  The only filter, and it filters by asserting. Every row's licence
        group must be shippable (A, B or N) and must agree with sources.csv,
        or the build fails before a byte of output exists.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from .canonical_io import (CanonicalError, counts, raise_if_invalid, read_canonical, write_rows)
from .dictionary import Dictionary
from .lake import Lake, sha256_file, staged_directory, tool_revision, utc_now, write_json
from .licence import LicenceViolation, assert_shippable
from .model import BASES, validate

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1


def _sql_list(items) -> str:
    return ", ".join(f"'{item}'" for item in sorted(items))


def schema_sql(dictionary: Dictionary) -> str:
    """Bundle schema v1. AlmanacCore's Migration008 mirrors these tables."""
    groups = _sql_list(dictionary.shippable_groups)
    no_amount = _sql_list(q for q, row in dictionary.qualifiers.items() if row.amount_rule == "null")
    return f"""
CREATE TABLE bundle_meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_source (
    namespace     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    name          TEXT NOT NULL,
    release       TEXT NOT NULL,
    licence       TEXT NOT NULL,
    licence_group TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (licence_group IN ({groups})),
    attribution   TEXT NOT NULL,
    url           TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_nutrient (
    nutrient_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    infoods_tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_qualifier (
    qualifier         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    has_quantity      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (has_quantity IN (0, 1)),
    directly_observed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (directly_observed IN (0, 1)),
    amount_rule       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_rule IN ('null', 'required')),
    description       TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_food (
    food_ref        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    namespace       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_source (namespace),
    local_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    licence_group   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (licence_group IN ({groups})),
    food_group_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    food_group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_record   TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (namespace, local_id),
    CHECK (food_ref = namespace || ':' || local_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_food_name (
    food_ref   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_food (food_ref),
    language   TEXT NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name <> ''),
    is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_primary IN (0, 1)),
    PRIMARY KEY (food_ref, language)
) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE nutrition_value (
    food_ref           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_food (food_ref),
    nutrient_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_nutrient (nutrient_id),
    basis              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ({_sql_list(BASES)})),
    amount             REAL CHECK (amount IS NULL OR amount >= 0),
    qualifier          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nutrition_qualifier (qualifier),
    confidence         TEXT,
    source_value       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_value <> ''),
    source_nutrient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_unit        TEXT NOT NULL,
    licence_group      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (licence_group IN ({groups})),
    PRIMARY KEY (food_ref, nutrient_id, basis),
    CHECK ((qualifier IN ({no_amount})) = (amount IS NULL)),
    CHECK (qualifier <> 'zero_reported' OR amount = 0)
) STRICT;
"""


def union(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> dict:
    """Concatenates every canonical/{namespace}/ present. Deleting one removes that source."""
    root = lake.canonical_root
    present = sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir()
                     if p.is_dir() and not p.name.startswith(".")) if root.is_dir() else []
    if not present:
        raise CanonicalError(f"{root}: no canonical sources to union")
    foods, names, values, sources = [], [], [], {}
    for namespace in present:
        if namespace not in dictionary.sources:
            raise CanonicalError(f"canonical/{namespace}: namespace is not in dictionary/sources.csv")
        f, n, v, manifest = read_canonical(root / namespace)
        if manifest.get("namespace") != namespace:
            raise CanonicalError(f"canonical/{namespace}: manifest names {manifest.get('namespace')!r}")
        if manifest.get("dictionary_sha256") != dictionary.sha256:
            raise CanonicalError(f"canonical/{namespace} was built against a different dictionary; "
                                 f"re-run `canonicalise {namespace}`")
        raise_if_invalid(validate(f, n, v, dictionary, namespace=namespace), f"canonical/{namespace}")
        foods += f
        names += n
        values += v
        sources[namespace] = {"release": manifest["release"],
                              "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(root / namespace / "manifest.json"),
                              "counts": manifest["counts"]}
    raise_if_invalid(validate(foods, names, values, dictionary), "union")
    with staged_directory(lake.union) as scratch:
        manifest = {
            "stage": "union",
            "sources": sources,
            "dictionary_sha256": dictionary.sha256,
            "generated_at": utc_now(),
            "tool_revision": tool_revision(),
            "outputs": write_rows(scratch, foods, names, values),
            "counts": counts(foods, names, values),
        }
        write_json(scratch / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest


def _verify_written(con: sqlite3.Connection, shippable: frozenset[str]) -> None:
    """Second assertion, against what is actually in the file."""
    for table in ("nutrition_source", "nutrition_food", "nutrition_value"):
        for (group,) in con.execute(f"SELECT DISTINCT licence_group FROM {table}"):
            if group not in shippable:
                raise LicenceViolation(f"BUILD FAILURE: {table} contains licence group {group!r}")
    if (result := con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]) != "ok":
        raise CanonicalError(f"bundle integrity_check: {result}")
    if violations := con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall():
        raise CanonicalError(f"bundle foreign_key_check: {violations[:5]}")


def build(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary, out_path: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    out_path = Path(out_path or lake.bundle)
    foods, names, values, union_manifest = read_canonical(lake.union)
    if union_manifest.get("dictionary_sha256") != dictionary.sha256:
        raise CanonicalError("processed/union was built against a different dictionary; re-run union")
    raise_if_invalid(validate(foods, names, values, dictionary), "union")

    # The assertion. Nothing has been written yet.
    shippable = dictionary.shippable_groups
    checked = assert_shippable(((f.food_ref, f.licence_group) for f in foods), shippable)
    checked += assert_shippable((("/".join((v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis)), v.licence_group)
                                 for v in values), shippable)
    namespaces = sorted({f.namespace for f in foods})
    assert_shippable(((ns, dictionary.group_of(ns)) for ns in namespaces), shippable)

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    scratch = out_path.with_name(f".{out_path.name}.partial")
    scratch.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    built_at = utc_now()
    meta = {
        "schema_version": str(SCHEMA_VERSION),
        "dictionary_sha256": dictionary.sha256,
        "built_at": built_at,
        "tool_revision": tool_revision(),
        "union_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(lake.union / "manifest.json"),
        "sources": json.dumps({ns: dictionary.sources[ns].release for ns in namespaces},
                              sort_keys=True),
    }
    try:
        con = sqlite3.connect(scratch)
        try:
            con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
            con.executescript(schema_sql(dictionary))
            with con:
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO bundle_meta VALUES (?, ?)", sorted(meta.items()))
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_source VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (s.namespace, s.dataset_id, s.name, s.release, s.licence, s.licence_group,
                     s.attribution, s.url)
                    for s in (dictionary.sources[ns] for ns in namespaces)])
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_nutrient VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (n.nutrient_id, n.infoods_tag, n.name, n.unit, n.description)
                    for n in dictionary.nutrients.values()])
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_qualifier VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (q.qualifier, int(q.has_quantity), int(q.directly_observed), q.amount_rule,
                     q.description)
                    for q in dictionary.qualifiers.values()])
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_food VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (f.food_ref, f.namespace, f.local_id, f.licence_group, f.food_group_code,
                     f.food_group_name, f.source_record)
                    for f in sorted(foods, key=lambda f: f.food_ref)])
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_food_name VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (n.food_ref, n.language, n.name, int(n.is_primary))
                    for n in sorted(names, key=lambda n: (n.food_ref, n.language))])
                con.executemany("INSERT INTO nutrition_value VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                    (v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis, v.amount, v.qualifier, v.confidence or None,
                     v.source_value, v.source_nutrient_id, v.source_unit, v.licence_group)
                    for v in sorted(values, key=lambda v: (v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis))])
            _verify_written(con, shippable)
            con.execute("VACUUM")
        finally:
            con.close()
        os.replace(scratch, out_path)
    except BaseException:
        scratch.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    return {
        "path": str(out_path),
        "sha256": sha256_file(out_path),
        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "built_at": built_at,
        "namespaces": namespaces,
        "rows_checked": checked,
        "counts": counts(foods, names, values),
    }

"""python3 -m almanac_nutrition <command> — see ../README.md."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from . import bundle, fixture, qa
from .canonical_io import CanonicalError
from .dictionary import DictionaryError, load
from .lake import InputVerificationError, Lake
from .licence import LicenceViolation
from .sources import load_sources

FAILURES = (CanonicalError, DictionaryError, InputVerificationError, LicenceViolation)


def _summary(manifest: dict) -> str:
    c = manifest["counts"]
    return (f"{c['foods']} foods, {c['names']} names, {c['values']} values; "
            f"qualifiers {json.dumps(c['values_by_qualifier'])}")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    sources = load_sources()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="almanac_nutrition", description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--lake", help="food-data lake root "
                                       "(default: $ALMANAC_FOOD_DATA or ~/ALManac-food-data)")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("extract", "canonicalise"):
        commands.add_parser(name).add_argument("source", choices=sorted(sources))
    commands.add_parser("union")
    commands.add_parser("bundle")
    commands.add_parser("all", help="extract and canonicalise every source, then union and bundle")
    commands.add_parser("qa", help="re-read every raw cell and check the canonical, union and bundle stages")
    commands.add_parser("fixture", help="regenerate fixtures/bundle_v1.sql for AlmanacCore's tests")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    lake = Lake(args.lake)
    try:
        dictionary = load()
        if args.command == "extract":
            print(f"extracted {args.source} -> {sources[args.source].extract(lake)}")
        elif args.command == "canonicalise":
            print(f"canonical {args.source}: {_summary(sources[args.source].canonicalise(lake, dictionary))}")
        elif args.command == "union":
            print(f"union: {_summary(bundle.union(lake, dictionary))}")
        elif args.command == "fixture":
            print(f"fixture -> {fixture.write(dictionary)}")
        elif args.command == "qa":
            report = qa.run(lake, dictionary)
            print(qa.summary(report))
            return 0 if report["passed"] else 1
        elif args.command == "bundle":
            report = bundle.build(lake, dictionary)
            print(f"bundle {report['path']} ({', '.join(report['namespaces'])}): "
                  f"{report['rows_checked']} rows passed the licence assertion; sha256 {report['sha256']}")
        else:
            for namespace, module in sources.items():
                module.extract(lake)
                print(f"canonical {namespace}: {_summary(module.canonicalise(lake, dictionary))}")
            print(f"union: {_summary(bundle.union(lake, dictionary))}")
            report = bundle.build(lake, dictionary)
            print(f"bundle {report['path']}: {report['rows_checked']} rows passed the licence "
                  f"assertion; sha256 {report['sha256']}")
    except FAILURES as error:
        print(f"FAILED: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0

1	"""Quality assurance over what the pipeline wrote — the data:validate-data pass.
2	
3	Independent of the source modules on purpose: every mapped raw cell is re-read
4	here with its own reader and compared with what canonicalise wrote, so a
5	parser bug cannot pass its own test. `python3 -m almanac_nutrition qa` writes
6	processed/qa/report.md and report.json, and exits non-zero if a hard check fails.
7	
8	Hard checks — the bundle must not ship if any fails:
9	  fidelity   every mapped raw cell has exactly one canonical row with the same
10	             number, bound or token, and no canonical row lacks a raw cell
11	  tokens     no row whose cell is a token carries an amount; no 0 without a raw 0
12	  licence    every union and bundle row is shippable and agrees with sources.csv
13	Soft checks — reported for a person to review:
14	  plausibility  protein + fat + total carbohydrate + alcohol above 105 g per 100 g
15	  energy        Almanac's general Atwater figure against each publisher's own
16	"""
17	from __future__ import annotations

19	import csv
20	import math
21	import sqlite3

34	# What each publisher's own documentation says its tokens mean. Deliberately not read
35	# from dictionary/value_tokens.csv, so that a wrong mapping there is caught here.
36	TOKENS = {("cofid", "Tr"): "trace", ("cofid", "N"): "not_analysed",
37	          ("ciqual", "traces"): "trace", ("ciqual", "-"): "not_analysed"}
38	NO_AMOUNT = {"trace", "not_analysed"}
39	EXAMPLES = 12
40	Cells = dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[tuple[int, str, Mapping]]]

43	def _text(value: object) -> str:
44	    if value is None:
45	        return ""
46	    return repr(value) if isinstance(value, float) else str(value)

49	def _mapped(dictionary: Dictionary, source: str) -> dict[str, Mapping]:
50	    return {m.source_nutrient_id: m for m in dictionary.mappings if m.source == source}
51	
52	
53	def _number(text: str) -> float | None:
54	    try:
55	        number = float(text.replace(",", ".") if text.count(",") == 1 and "." not in text else text)
56	    except ValueError:
57	        return None
58	    return number if math.isfinite(number) else None

61	# --- Independent readers of the raw files ------------------------------------------------
62	
63	def raw_usda(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> tuple[set[str], Cells]:
64	    base = lake.source_dir("usda") / "FoodData_Central_csv_2026-04-30"
65	    with open(base / "foundation_food.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
66	        listed = {r["fdc_id"] for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
67	    with open(base / "food.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
68	        foods = {r["fdc_id"] for r in csv.DictReader(f)
69	                 if r["data_type"] == "foundation_food" and r["fdc_id"] in listed}
70	    mapped = _mapped(dictionary, "usda")
71	    cells: Cells = defaultdict(list)
72	    with open(base / "food_nutrient.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
73	        reader = csv.reader(f)
74	        header = next(reader)
75	        fdc, nutrient, amount = header.index("fdc_id"), header.index("nutrient_id"), header.index("amount")
76	        for row in reader:
77	            m = mapped.get(row[nutrient])
78	            if m and row[fdc] in foods and row[amount].strip():
79	                cells[(f"usda:{row[fdc]}", m.nutrient_id, "per_100g")].append(
80	                    (m.priority, row[amount].strip(), m))

84	def raw_ciqual(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> tuple[set[str], Cells]:
85	    base = lake.source_dir("ciqual")
86	    root = etree.parse(str(base / "alim_2025_11_03.xml")).getroot()
87	    foods = {f"ciqual:{(e.findtext('alim_code') or '').strip()}" for e in root}
88	    mapped = _mapped(dictionary, "ciqual")
89	    cells: Cells = defaultdict(list)
90	    for _, e in etree.iterparse(str(base / "compo_2025_11_03.xml"), tag="COMPO"):
91	        m = mapped.get((e.findtext("const_code") or "").strip())
92	        text = (e.findtext("teneur") or "").strip()
93	        if m and text:
94	            cells[(f"ciqual:{(e.findtext('alim_code') or '').strip()}", m.nutrient_id, "per_100g")].append(
95	                (m.priority, text, m))
96	        e.clear()

100	def _sheet(path, title: str) -> list[list[object]]:
101	    book = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
102	    try:
103	        return [list(row) for row in book[title].iter_rows(values_only=True)]
104	    finally:
105	        book.close()

107	
108	def _at(row: list[object], index: int) -> str:
109	    return _text(row[index] if index < len(row) else None).strip()
110

112	def raw_cofid(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> tuple[set[str], Cells]:
113	    rows = _sheet(lake.source_dir("cofid") / "McCance_Widdowsons_Composition_of_Foods_Integrated_Dataset_2021.xlsx",
114	                  "1.3 Proximates")
115	    headings, codes = rows[0], rows[1]
116	    column = {_text(c).strip(): i for i, c in enumerate(codes) if c}
117	    code_at, group_at = headings.index("Food Code"), headings.index("Group")
118	    body = [(n, row) for n, row in enumerate(rows[3:], start=4) if _at(row, code_at)]
119	    repeats = Counter(_at(row, code_at) for _, row in body)
120	    mapped = _mapped(dictionary, "cofid")
121	    foods: set[str] = set()
122	    cells: Cells = defaultdict(list)
123	    for n, row in body:
124	        code = _at(row, code_at)
125	        ref = f"cofid:{code}" if repeats[code] == 1 else f"cofid:{code}@row{n}"
126	        foods.add(ref)
127	        # CoFID user guide p.7: alcoholic beverages (group Q) are per 100 ml.
128	        basis = "per_100ml" if _at(row, group_at).startswith("Q") else "per_100g"
129	        for source_id, m in mapped.items():
130	            if text := _at(row, column[source_id]):
131	                cells[(ref, m.nutrient_id, basis)].append((m.priority, text, m))
132	    return foods, cells
133	
134	
135	def raw_afcd(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> tuple[set[str], Cells]:
136	    path = lake.source_dir("ausnut") / "AFCD Release 3 - Nutrient profiles.xlsx"
137	    mapped = _mapped(dictionary, "afcd")
138	    foods: set[str] = set()
139	    cells: Cells = defaultdict(list)
140	    for title, basis in (("All solids & liquids per 100 g", "per_100g"), ("Liquids only per 100 mL", "per_100ml")):
141	        rows = _sheet(path, title)
142	        column = {" ".join(_text(h).split()): i for i, h in enumerate(rows[2])}
143	        for row in rows[3:]:
144	            if not (key := _at(row, column["Public Food Key"])):
145	                continue
146	            if basis == "per_100g":
147	                foods.add(f"afcd:{key}")
148	            for source_id, m in mapped.items():
149	                if text := _at(row, column[source_id]):
150	                    cells[(f"afcd:{key}", m.nutrient_id, basis)].append((m.priority, text, m))
151	    return foods, cells

153	
154	READERS = {"usda": raw_usda, "ciqual": raw_ciqual, "cofid": raw_cofid, "afcd": raw_afcd}
155	
156	
157	# --- Hard checks --------------------------------------------------------------------------
158	
159	def expectation(source: str, text: str) -> tuple[str, float | None]:
160	    """What the publisher's own documentation says a cell is: a kind and, if any, a number."""
161	    if (source, text) in TOKENS:
162	        return TOKENS[(source, text)], None
163	    if source == "ciqual" and text.startswith("<"):
164	        return "below_loq", _number(text[1:].strip())
165	    number = _number(text)
166	    if number is None:
167	        return "unreadable", None
168	    if number < 0:
169	        return "negative", number
170	    return ("zero" if number == 0 else "number"), number
171	
172	
173	def fidelity(source: str, raw_foods: set[str], cells: Cells, foods, values, manifest) -> dict:
174	    problems: list[str] = []
175	    canonical_foods = {f.food_ref for f in foods}
176	    for ref in sorted(raw_foods - canonical_foods):
177	        problems.append(f"food {ref} is in the raw file but not canonical")
178	    for ref in sorted(canonical_foods - raw_foods):
179	        problems.append(f"food {ref} is canonical but not in the raw file")
180	    by_key = {(v.food_ref, v.nutrient_id, v.basis): v for v in values}
181	    rejected = {(r["food_ref"], r["source_nutrient_id"], r.get("basis", "per_100g"))
182	                for r in manifest["notes"].get("rejected_values", [])}
183	    kinds: Counter[str] = Counter()
184	    for key, found in sorted(cells.items()):
185	        found.sort(key=lambda c: c[0])
186	        # The pipeline's priority rule restated: the lowest priority that is not "no number".
187	        _, text, m = next((c for c in found if TOKENS.get((source, c[1])) != "not_analysed"), found[0])
188	        kind, number = expectation(source, text)
189	        kinds[kind] += 1
190	        where, v = "/".join(key), by_key.get(key)
191	        if kind == "negative":
192	            if v is not None:
193	                problems.append(f"{where}: negative raw cell {text!r} became a row")
194	            elif (key[0], m.source_nutrient_id, key[2]) not in rejected:
195	                problems.append(f"{where}: negative raw cell {text!r} is not recorded as rejected")
196	            continue
197	        if v is None:
198	            problems.append(f"{where}: raw cell {text!r} has no canonical row")
199	            continue
200	        if (v.source_value, v.source_nutrient_id) != (text, m.source_nutrient_id):
201	            problems.append(f"{where}: canonical cell {v.source_value!r} ({v.source_nutrient_id}), "
202	                            f"raw {text!r} ({m.source_nutrient_id})")
203	        if kind in NO_AMOUNT:
204	            if v.amount is not None or v.qualifier != kind:
205	                problems.append(f"{where}: raw token {text!r} became {v.qualifier} {v.amount!r}")
206	            continue
207	        if kind == "unreadable":
208	            problems.append(f"{where}: raw cell {text!r} is unreadable but became {v.qualifier}")
209	            continue
210	        wanted = number / KJ_PER_KCAL if m.unit_conversion == "kj_to_kcal" else number
211	        if v.amount is None or not math.isclose(v.amount, wanted, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12):
212	            problems.append(f"{where}: amount {v.amount!r}, raw {text!r} gives {wanted!r}")
213	        if kind == "zero" and v.qualifier != "zero_reported":
214	            problems.append(f"{where}: raw zero became {v.qualifier}")
215	        if kind == "below_loq" and v.qualifier != "below_loq":
216	            problems.append(f"{where}: raw bound {text!r} became {v.qualifier}")
217	        if kind == "number" and v.qualifier in NO_AMOUNT | {"zero_reported", "below_loq"}:
218	            problems.append(f"{where}: raw number {text!r} became {v.qualifier}")
219	    for key in sorted(set(by_key) - set(cells)):
220	        problems.append(f"{'/'.join(key)}: canonical row with no raw cell")
221	    return {"raw_cells": sum(kinds.values()), "raw_cells_by_kind": dict(sorted(kinds.items())),
222	            "canonical_values": len(values), "problems": len(problems), "examples": problems[:EXAMPLES]}
223	
224	
225	def token_invariants(values) -> dict:
226	    tokens = {token for _, token in TOKENS}
227	    carried = [v for v in values if v.source_value.strip() in tokens and v.amount is not None]
228	    zero = [v for v in values if v.amount == 0 and _number(v.source_value.strip()) != 0]
229	    by_token = Counter(v.source_value.strip() for v in values if v.source_value.strip() in tokens)
230	    examples = [f"{v.food_ref}/{v.nutrient_id}: {v.source_value!r} -> {v.amount!r}" for v in carried + zero]
231	    return {"token_rows": dict(sorted(by_token.items())), "tokens_with_amounts": len(carried),
232	            "zeros_without_a_raw_zero": len(zero), "problems": len(carried) + len(zero),
233	            "examples": examples[:EXAMPLES]}
234	
235	
236	def licence(dictionary: Dictionary, foods, values, bundle_path) -> dict:
237	    problems: list[str] = []
238	    shippable = dictionary.shippable_groups
239	    group_of_food = {}
240	    for f in foods:
241	        group_of_food[f.food_ref] = f.licence_group
242	        if f.licence_group != dictionary.group_of(f.namespace) or f.licence_group not in shippable:
243	            problems.append(f"food {f.food_ref}: group {f.licence_group}")
244	    problems += [f"value {v.food_ref}/{v.nutrient_id}: group {v.licence_group}"
245	                 for v in values if v.licence_group != group_of_food.get(v.food_ref)]
246	    in_bundle: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
247	    with closing(sqlite3.connect(f"file:{bundle_path}?mode=ro", uri=True)) as con:
248	        for table in ("nutrition_source", "nutrition_food", "nutrition_value"):
249	            in_bundle[table] = sorted(g for (g,) in con.execute(f"SELECT DISTINCT licence_group FROM {table}"))
250	            problems += [f"bundle {table}: group {g}" for g in in_bundle[table] if g not in shippable]
251	        problems += [f"bundle nutrition_source {ns}: no attribution"
252	                     for ns, text in con.execute("SELECT namespace, attribution FROM nutrition_source")
253	                     if not text.strip()]
254	    return {"groups_in_bundle": in_bundle, "problems": len(problems), "examples": problems[:EXAMPLES]}
255	
256	
257	# --- Soft checks --------------------------------------------------------------------------
258	
259	def _grams(v) -> float | None:
260	    """A value as it enters the general-Atwater sum (AlmanacCore's rule, restated here)."""
261	    if v is None or v.qualifier == "not_analysed":
262	        return None
263	    return 0.0 if v.qualifier in ("trace", "below_loq") else v.amount
264	
265	
266	def general_atwater(values: dict) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
267	    """(kcal, grams of protein + fat + total carbohydrate + alcohol), or None."""
268	    protein, fat = _grams(values.get("protein")), _grams(values.get("fat_total"))
269	    carbohydrate = _grams(values.get("carbohydrate_by_difference"))
270	    if carbohydrate is None:
271	        fibre = _grams(values.get("fibre_total_dietary"))
272	        available = _grams(values.get("carbohydrate_available"))
273	        if available is None:
274	            available = _grams(values.get("carbohydrate_available_monosaccharide"))
275	        carbohydrate = None if fibre is None or available is None else available + fibre
276	    if protein is None or fat is None or carbohydrate is None:
277	        return None
278	    alcohol = _grams(values.get("alcohol")) or 0.0
279	    return (4 * protein + 4 * carbohydrate + 9 * fat + 7 * alcohol,
280	            protein + fat + carbohydrate + alcohol)
281	
282	
283	def energy_and_plausibility(names, values) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
284	    primary = {n.food_ref: n.name for n in names if n.is_primary}
285	    by_pair: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = defaultdict(dict)
286	    for v in values:
287	        by_pair[(v.food_ref, v.basis)][v.nutrient_id] = v
288	    sources: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(lambda: {"pairs": 0, "general_atwater": 0, "publisher_only": 0,
289	                                                    "neither": 0, "ratios": [], "outliers": []})
290	    usda_published: list[float] = []
291	    implausible: list[dict] = []
292	    for (ref, basis), found in sorted(by_pair.items()):
293	        s = sources[ref.split(":", 1)[0]]
294	        s["pairs"] += 1
295	        estimate = general_atwater(found)
296	        published = found.get("energy_kcal")
297	        published_kcal = (published.amount if published is not None and published.qualifier != "below_loq"
298	                          else None)
299	        if estimate is None:
300	            s["publisher_only" if published_kcal is not None else "neither"] += 1
301	            continue
302	        kcal, grams = estimate
303	        s["general_atwater"] += 1
304	        if basis == "per_100g" and grams > 105:
305	            implausible.append({"food_ref": ref, "name": primary.get(ref, ""), "grams": round(grams, 2)})
306	        if published_kcal:
307	            s["ratios"].append(kcal / published_kcal)
308	            if abs(kcal - published_kcal) > max(30.0, 0.3 * published_kcal):
309	                s["outliers"].append({"food_ref": ref, "basis": basis, "name": primary.get(ref, ""),
310	                                      "general_atwater": round(kcal, 1), "published": round(published_kcal, 1)})
311	        if (usda := found.get("energy_general_atwater_kcal")) is not None and usda.amount is not None:
312	            usda_published.append(abs(kcal - usda.amount))
313	    energy = {}
314	    for ns, s in sorted(sources.items()):
315	        ratios = sorted(s.pop("ratios"))
316	        cuts = statistics.quantiles(ratios, n=20) if len(ratios) >= 20 else []
317	        s["ratio_general_atwater_to_published"] = (
318	            {"n": len(ratios), "p5": round(cuts[0], 3), "median": round(statistics.median(ratios), 3),
319	             "p95": round(cuts[-1], 3)} if cuts else {"n": len(ratios)})
320	        s["outlier_count"] = len(s["outliers"])
321	        s["outliers"] = sorted(s["outliers"], key=lambda o: -abs(o["general_atwater"] - o["published"]))[:EXAMPLES]
322	        energy[ns] = s
323	    if usda_published:
324	        energy["usda_general_atwater_agreement"] = {
325	            "n": len(usda_published), "median_abs_kcal": round(statistics.median(usda_published), 3),
326	            "over_1_kcal": sum(1 for d in usda_published if d > 1)}
327	    return energy, {"over_105_g": len(implausible),
328	                    "examples": sorted(implausible, key=lambda i: -i["grams"])[:EXAMPLES]}
329	
330	
331	# --- Report -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
332	
333	def run(lake: Lake, dictionary: Dictionary) -> dict:
334	    union_foods, union_names, union_values, _ = read_canonical(lake.union)

            if not headings[col].strip().endswith(f"({m.source_unit})"):
                raise CanonicalError(f"nutrient_map.csv gives {NAMESPACE} {m.source_nutrient_id} unit "
                                     f"{m.source_unit!r}; {FOOD_SHEET} row 1 says {headings[col]!r}")
            columns[m.source_nutrient_id] = col

                for n, row in body if not cell(row, code_col).strip() and any(c.strip() for c in row)]
    occurrences = Counter(cell(row, code_col).strip() for _, row in coded)

        if occurrences[code] > 1:

            local_id = f"{code}@row{n}"
            entry = collisions.setdefault(code, {"food_code": code, "rows": [], "local_ids": [],

            entry["rows"].append(n)

            entry["names"].append(cell(row, name_col).strip())

                    f"{FOOD_SHEET}!row {n}")
        foods.append((food, n, row))
        names.append(FoodName(food.food_ref, "en", cell(row, name_col).strip(), True))

    values: list[Value] = []
    rejected: list[dict] = []
    for food, n, row in foods:
        basis = basis_of(food.food_group_code)
        for nutrient_id, maps in mappings.items():
            candidates = []
            for m in maps:
                text = cell(row, columns[m.source_nutrient_id])
                if not text.strip():
                    continue  # blank: CoFID says nothing, so there is no row
                try:
                    qualified = qualify(text, tokens=tokens, numeric_override=m.numeric_qualifier_override)
                except NegativeAmount:
                    rejected.append({"food_ref": food.food_ref, "source_nutrient_id": m.source_nutrient_id,
                                     "source_value": text.strip(), "reason": "negative amount"})

                candidates.append((m.priority, qualified, (m, text.strip())))
            chosen = select(candidates)
            if chosen is None:
                continue
            _, qualified, (m, source_value) = chosen
            values.append(Value(food.food_ref, nutrient_id, basis,
                                convert(qualified.amount, m.unit_conversion), qualified.qualifier,
                                "", source_value, m.source_nutrient_id, m.source_unit, group))

    by_ref = {food.food_ref: (food, names[i].name) for i, (food, _, _) in enumerate(foods)}
    notes = {

        "not_canonicalised": [f"{WORKBOOK}: every sheet but {FOOD_SHEET}",
                              f"{OLD_FOODS}: every sheet (superseded analyses)"],
        "basis_rule": f"per_100ml for food groups starting {ALCOHOLIC_GROUP_PREFIX!r} (alcoholic "
                      "beverages: user guide p.7, sheet 1.1 Notes); per_100g for every other food",
        "per_100ml_foods": [{"food_ref": f.food_ref, "food_group_code": f.food_group_code,
                             "name": by_ref[f.food_ref][1]}
                            for f, _, _ in foods if basis_of(f.food_group_code) == "per_100ml"],
        # Alcohol in a food outside group Q: per_100g by the rule above. Listed so that a
        # reviewer can see every such food (dishes cooked with wine, and Irish coffee).
        "alcohol_outside_alcoholic_groups": [
            {"food_ref": v.food_ref, "food_group_code": by_ref[v.food_ref][0].food_group_code,
             "name": by_ref[v.food_ref][1], "source_value": v.source_value, "basis": v.basis}
            for v in values if v.nutrient_id == "alcohol" and v.amount and v.basis == "per_100g"],
        "food_group_names": f"user guide {GUIDE} (sha256 {GUIDE_SHA256}) Appendix B",
        "food_groups_not_in_appendix_b": unlisted_groups,
        "collisions": list(collisions.values()),
        "excluded": excluded,
        "rejected_values": rejected,
    }
    return write_canonical(lake.canonical(NAMESPACE), namespace=NAMESPACE,
                           foods=[food for food, _, _ in foods], names=names, values=values,
                           dictionary=dictionary, inputs=[food_input], notes=notes)

        names.append(FoodName(food.food_ref, "en", cell(row, name_col).strip(), True))

    values: list[Value] = []
    rejected: list[dict] = []
    for food, n, row in foods:
        basis = basis_of(food.food_group_code)
        for nutrient_id, maps in mappings.items():
            candidates = []
            for m in maps:
                text = cell(row, columns[m.source_nutrient_id])
                if not text.strip():
                    continue  # blank: CoFID says nothing, so there is no row
                try:
                    qualified = qualify(text, tokens=tokens, numeric_override=m.numeric_qualifier_override)
                except NegativeAmount:
                    rejected.append({"food_ref": food.food_ref, "source_nutrient_id": m.source_nutrient_id,
                                     "source_value": text.strip(), "reason": "negative amount"})
                    continue
                except UnrecognisedValue as error:
                    raise CanonicalError(f"{food.food_ref} ({FOOD_SHEET}!row {n}) "
                                         f"{m.source_nutrient_id}: {error}") from error
                candidates.append((m.priority, qualified, (m, text.strip())))
            chosen = select(candidates)
            if chosen is None:
                continue
            _, qualified, (m, source_value) = chosen
            values.append(Value(food.food_ref, nutrient_id, basis,
                                convert(qualified.amount, m.unit_conversion), qualified.qualifier,
                                "", source_value, m.source_nutrient_id, m.source_unit, group))

    by_ref = {food.food_ref: (food, names[i].name) for i, (food, _, _) in enumerate(foods)}
    notes = {
        "sheet": FOOD_SHEET,
        "not_canonicalised": [f"{WORKBOOK}: every sheet but {FOOD_SHEET}",
                              f"{OLD_FOODS}: every sheet (superseded analyses)"],
        "basis_rule": f"per_100ml for food groups starting {ALCOHOLIC_GROUP_PREFIX!r} (alcoholic "
                      "beverages: user guide p.7, sheet 1.1 Notes); per_100g for every other food",
        "per_100ml_foods": [{"food_ref": f.food_ref, "food_group_code": f.food_group_code,
                             "name": by_ref[f.food_ref][1]}
                            for f, _, _ in foods if basis_of(f.food_group_code) == "per_100ml"],
        # Alcohol in a food outside group Q: per_100g by the rule above. Listed so that a
        # reviewer can see every such food (dishes cooked with wine, and Irish coffee).
        "alcohol_outside_alcoholic_groups": [
            {"food_ref": v.food_ref, "food_group_code": by_ref[v.food_ref][0].food_group_code,
             "name": by_ref[v.food_ref][1], "source_value": v.source_value, "basis": v.basis}
            for v in values if v.nutrient_id == "alcohol" and v.amount and v.basis == "per_100g"],
        "food_group_names": f"user guide {GUIDE} (sha256 {GUIDE_SHA256}) Appendix B",
        "food_groups_not_in_appendix_b": unlisted_groups,
        "collisions": list(collisions.values()),
        "excluded": excluded,
        "rejected_values": rejected,
    }
    return write_canonical(lake.canonical(NAMESPACE), namespace=NAMESPACE,
                           foods=[food for food, _, _ in foods], names=names, values=values,
                           dictionary=dictionary, inputs=[food_input], notes=notes)
